date_selection_rule: For each coherent scene footprint/tile covering these unchanged centres, inspect chronological2020 candidates and use the first suitable valid metadata/coverage observation. The catalogue cloud<10 filter is a scene-level search convenience, never per-centre truth, physical classification or whole-neighbourhood gate. Record cloud/shadow/nodata limits and any uncovered centres. Do not choose a scene because it agrees with a desired surface answer or hunt further agreeing scenes after an adequate first observation.
required_actual_scene_metadata: Item id, acquisition datetime, full original metadata body/hash and returned footprint
Actual asset URLs for red/green/blue/NIR and native SCL; CRS/EPSG, grid shape, affine transform, data type, nodata, band scale/offset
Scene cloud/degraded/nodata/saturated/shadow quality metadata and processing baseline; these do not certify a centre clear
Per-centre actual native-frame containment using existing GDAL coordinate method; no fitted shift/clamp
Actual TIFF/COG block dimensions from a metadata-only header observation if later permitted; do not assume1024 from Vietnam
Asset HEAD opaque ETag/size/LastModified/range capability, without whole-COG hash claims
native_block_plan_status: Not constructible honestly until actual applicable IDN scene/grid/block metadata is available. No IDN scene, acquisition date, CRS, asset URL, affine, native index, coverage, block shape or quality observation has been invented.
native_block_method_once_actual_metadata: Reuse existing rasterio.warp.transform EPSG4326→actual source CRS and inverse native affine; preserve exact original centre and fractional position
Use floor native containing pixel with true source-frame bounds; retain outside-frame status and actual cross-scene coverage without clamp/resampling
Keep native10m red/green/blue/NIR and native20m SCL separate; never resample SCL into physical truth
Group required native pixels/context windows by actual COG block coordinates and de-duplicate source reads; record true cropped edge window dimensions
Save codes/reflectance and masks with exact native windows/source identities; show exact fractional centre in any subsequent display, with source values preserved
Cloud/shadow/nodata or remaining physical body ambiguity can remain unknown; no tide/legal/name/3x3-unanimity universal gate
missing_actual_facts: Authorized access to EarthSearch with the explicitly documented four source-derived geographical bounding-box payloads
Applicable2020 IDN item metadata and actual per-centre footprint/native-frame coverage
Actual asset/grid/quality/native-block metadata; therefore no complete dated read plan yet
